data.name: CliHelp
data.value:
PowerToys Workspaces CLI
 list [--id GUID | --name NAME] [--details] [--json]
 launch (--id GUID | --name NAME) [--timeout 1..600] [--json]
Details require a selector. Launch waits for window arrangement and permits normal Windows UAC.
Unverified elevated EXEs require one-time confirmation on the terminal (stderr); Enter skips. Redirected input or stderr cannot approve.
Administrator terminals automatically use a non-elevated worker in the same user's desktop session.
Ctrl+C stops further launches when acknowledged; existing applications are not closed.
data.comment: Do not translate executable names, commands or options beginning with --.
